name: cortex-deepseek-v41-flash
readme: Cortex: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Unsloth GGUF, UD-IQ1_M) on llama-server built from llama.cpp PR #30817. Needs >=150 GB total VRAM (2x RTX PRO 6000 96GB, 2x A100/H100 80GB) or IQ1_S on 1x H200 (set container start args: --quant IQ1_S). Set HF_TOKEN. The model (~250 GB) downloads into /workspace on first boot; OpenAI API on port 8080 (/v1/chat/completions).
